name: mac-dante-ethernet-adapter
lines: I'm trying to send audio out but no audio device is showing up, I can only pick my Mac speaker.
It's a Mac. I'm connecting it to our network with a USB to Cat 6 dongle, we use Dante.
Hmm, I don't think the Dante Virtual Soundcard app is actually running right now.
Okay yeah, it shows up now after I pressed Start. Thanks, bye.
expect: The agent establishes the platform (Mac), searches the docs with Mac + Dante + Ethernet adapter, and gives the documented Dante Virtual Soundcard steps (DVS running with the right network interface, Settings > General > Audio Device > Dante Virtual Soundcard) instead of declaring the setup undocumented.
